# Abdullah Azmat

> Abdullah Azmat is an AI engineer and full-stack developer based in Pakistan. He designs and ships AI agents, RAG-powered tools, intelligent automation, and high-performance web applications using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, React, Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB.

Abdullah is in his fifth semester of a BS in Computer Science at the National University of Modern Languages (NUML). He has placed second at HackaForge NUML 1.0 and HackaForge NUML 3.0, holds a MERN stack certificate from PNY Training, and has built 7+ products. He is available for select freelance and full-time projects.

## Primary page

- [Abdullah Azmat — AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer](https://abdullah-azmat-rho.vercel.app/): The complete portfolio: selected work, capabilities, achievements, and contact details.

## Selected work

- [Law Firm Intake & Client Management System](https://abdullah-azmat-rho.vercel.app/#work): Featured full-stack build for a law firm with intake workflows, client records, and an admin dashboard.
- [LegalIntel AI](https://abdullah-azmat-rho.vercel.app/#work): AI document intelligence for legal teams, with cited answers and clause-level risk analysis.
- [Web and e-commerce projects](https://abdullah-azmat-rho.vercel.app/#work): a venue booking platform, an esports tournament site, a boutique storefront, a commerce build, and a campus lost-and-found app.
